name: self.browser.batch
description: Runs one batched browser program for a subgoal; type, fill and expect take a secret by handle; a stop names its stop_cause; a blocked, empty or interstitial page is the cue to switch_engine to chromium and retry.

host.description: Runs one batched browser program for a subgoal in the attached run's browser; fill types supplied, reference, template or checked written text (receipt text_source, text_ref); a failing or no_progress stop returns a failed_receipt.
